name: Enable SMS Campaigns app
description: Call this when an account needs the SMS Campaigns feature turned on before SMS work can begin — for example a campaigns listing shows SMS as unavailable or locked, or a subsequent SMS campaign call fails because the app is not enabled. This only flips the account-level app entitlement; to create, edit, or send an actual SMS campaign, use the SMS campaign actions instead, and to read which apps are already on, use the feature-toggle read action rather than calling this to find out.
preconditions: The user must be authenticated against account-app.brevo.com with an active session for the target account.
The acting user must have permission to change account-level application settings.

updatedApplications.description: Identifier of the application whose enabled state was updated, observed as "sms-campaigns".

side_effects: The SMS Campaigns application becomes enabled for the account.
SMS campaign features and navigation entries become available in the web app for all users of the account.
